the Thinking label shows how long the current stretch of thinking has run and moves on each second, in the status line too when reasoning is hidden; afterwards the Reasoning label says how long the reply thought
a burst of streamed text is shown in steps, whole words at a time, and caught up within a moment; the caret holds still while it flows
with reduced motion, streamed text is shown as it arrives, without pacing
waiting for an approval or a command is not shown as thinking
with the agent on, Advanced offers three approval levels as inline buttons; a level above asking shows as a flag on the message box, and the note says what still asks
the workspace agent is off by default and turned on in Advanced, with no folder button on the message box; with neither a folder nor a place for new ones, sending says where to choose
Advanced shows the conversation's folder and where new ones are made, both chosen natively; a project folder can be chosen, and dropped for a new folder
as the agent works, each call rolls into one row in turn: the running call with its path or command, the one before it rolling out

agent calls are drawn by kind: a change as a coloured diff, a command with its folder and shell and the paths outside the folder it names, the current plan above them, and the step count in the status line
the plan takes a line of its own under Reasoning, not the space beside it; a command is named by its first working line, not its encoding setup
finished agent calls keep their results in the history, and the offline preview refuses to apply or run anything
sending without a folder gives the conversation a new one, named after the date and its first message, under the chosen place
the approval window shows the command in a fixed-width block with the paths outside the folder marked and listed; Decline has the focus, Approve cannot be pressed at once, and Esc declines
after a moment Approve answers yes; a change shows its diff in colour with no outside-paths box, and the page reports its own height so the window fits it
activity checks produced no unhandled JavaScript errors or external requests
scope: Linux Chromium with synthetic snapshots; emulated touch; no live MCP, sub-agent, API billing or native approval execution.
